## Vericode (Bitmask)

The `vericode` field on `ask_contract_offers` is computed from `machines.verification` + error fields. See `web/ask_offer.py:get_machine_vericode()`.

| Bit | Value | Meaning | Source |
|-----|-------|---------|--------|
| — | 0 | Unverified | `verification != 'verified'` and no deverified flag |
| — | 1 | Verified | `verification = 'verified'` AND `error_description IS NULL` AND `error_msg IS NULL` |
| bit 1 | 2 | Deverified flag | `verification = 'deverified'`. **Only disables VM search** — machine still appears in non-VM search. |
| bit 2 | 4 | Has error_description | `error_description IS NOT NULL` (nvidia_smi failures, bandwidth test failures) |
| bit 3 | 8 | Has error_msg | `error_msg IS NOT NULL` (daemon errors, CDI failures, PCIe issues) |
| bit 5 | 32 | Maintenance deverified | `vericode |= 32` during maintenance windows (soft deverify) |

Vericodes combine: 12 = error_description + error_msg, 36 = maintenance + error_description, etc.
limitation: Defines the documented bitmask mapping; does not establish current deployed web/ask_offer.py implementation or full error catalog.
